nextSteps.title: We understand the idea
nextSteps.text: We review what you share and identify the questions that will help us understand your project.

nextSteps.title: We explore the fit
nextSteps.text: We discuss your goals, the current setup, and the scope of a useful first step.

nextSteps.title: We agree on a direction
nextSteps.text: If there’s a fit, we outline a clear proposal and a practical plan to move forward.

faqs.question: Do I need a detailed brief?
faqs.answer: No. A short description of your idea or challenge is enough to start. Share whatever you already know, and we can explore the rest together.

faqs.question: Can we discuss a project in Dari or Pashto?
faqs.answer: You can write your inquiry in English, Dari, or Pashto. Include your preferred language when you contact us.

faqs.question: Should I include passwords or private data?
faqs.answer: Please send only a general description at this stage. If a project requires access to systems or sensitive information, we can agree on an appropriate way to share it later.
